options.name: limit
options.description: Return up to this limit of results where limit is between 0 and 100.

options.name: members
options.description: An array of member objects to add to an access group.

options.name: offset
options.description: The offset of the first result item to be returned.

options.name: sort
options.description: If verbose is true, sort the results by id, name, or email.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: transaction_id
options.description:
An optional transaction ID can be passed to your request, which can be useful for tracking calls through multiple services by using one identifier.
The header key must be set to Transaction-Id and the value is anything that you choose.
If no transaction ID is passed in, then a random ID is generated.

options.name: type
options.description: Filter the results by member type.

options.name: verbose
options.description: Return user's email and name for each user ID or the name for each service ID or trusted profile.
